# MOONLEE Knowledge Base
> Open-source press-on nail care, health, and cost guides by MOONLEE.

## Core Articles
- [You're Spending $1,600 a Year on Nails](https://knowledge.moonleehome.com/2026/04/01/nail-spending-1600-press-on-nails-vs-salon.html) — 12-month cost breakdown comparing press-ons vs salon gel.
- [Nail Greenies from Press-Ons](https://knowledge.moonleehome.com/2026/05/01/nail-greenies-pseudomonas-press-on-nails.html) — How to prevent and treat pseudomonas (greenies) under press-on nails.
- [How to Measure Press-On Nail Size](https://knowledge.moonleehome.com/2026/05/07/how-to-measure-press-on-nail-size.html) — Professional paper strip method, including sizing fixes for flat nail beds.
- [Press-On Nails Glue vs. Adhesive Tabs](https://knowledge.moonleehome.com/2026/05/17/press-on-nails-glue-vs-adhesive-tabs-myth.html) — Debunking the 21-day wear myth of nail glue and comparing it with 3M adhesive tabs.
